==Description==
The '''Carrier''', in-game referred to as '''Carrier 1''' despite there only being one Carrier enemy, was a large, four-legged enemy, whom upon its death, exploded into 4 [[Swarm|Swarms]], and created a large green bile bubble that stunned towers that were caught within it.

==Appearance==
The '''Carrier''' had four dark green legs with claws. It was taller and wider than the average enemy. It had a long, light green, bent neck as well as a green head with glowing red eyes and a smile face, and it did not possess arms.

==Strategy==
*The '''Carrier''' will not destroy or stun any [[Military Base]] [[units]] or [[Crook]]s from the [[Crook Boss]] if any of them are caught in the explosion upon the '''Carrier's''' death.
**This makes [[units]] very useful in defeating the [[Swarm]]s that spawn, if your towers are stunned.
*Long-range towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Sniper]], are effective against the '''Carrier''' as they can shoot it from a long distance away and not be caught in the explosion.
*The explosion radius is nearly unavoidable by ground towers.
**If required, you can use the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability to stop the '''Carriers''' or the [[Swarm]]s in their track, before they get to close to your towers.

==Trivia==
*In the game, this was called the ''Carrier 1'', even though there was never a ''Carrier 2''.
*The '''Carrier's''' design was inspired by the [[w:c:mcmobs:Mutant Creeper|Mutant Creeper]], a modded mob in ''Minecraft''.
*Before the first wave in which the '''Carrier''' appeared, the text "''Awwww man....''" was a reference to the song [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cPJUBQd-PNM Revenge] by CaptainSparklez's when he says, "''Creeper? Awww man.''"
